table.name: TLGNR_TRUCK_TYPE_BS
table.description: Types of Trucks. The type of a truck characterizes its length/weight/special ability and is used in the restriction/prioritization for a shipto, see tlgnc_shipto_truck_type. Examples: 2-axle truck, ..., 5-axle truck, Semi-trailer truck, Silosteller.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=2-axle truck, ... 4=5-axle truck, 5=Semi-trailer truck (Sattelschlepper), 6=Silosteller truck.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_SHORT_NAME
column.description: Unique LOGON short name for identifying the truck type. Short names will be maintained to resemble the SAP Vehicle Type Codes but don't need to be identical. Not used in the application. Examples: A012, M030, N009.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.

column.name: volume_m3
column.description: Loading capacity of the truck in cubic meters. Used for calculation (order entry, exact customer order) if the order is not yet scheduled on a real truck and the base unit of the material is in cubic meters.

column.name: PLANNING_NET_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Planned/estimated max net weight in tons of the truck type: used in order entry to initialize the quantity per delivery field and for Uom 'Truck' nominator/denominator determination once the order gets persisted.
